item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:40 HKT 25/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect southern China tomorrow. A broad band of clouds will cover the coastal areas in the following couple of days. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China over next weekend.
